address: 6 Turnham Green Terrace, Chiswick, London W4 1QP
pricing_notes: All dishes are 100% halal (stated on the restaurant's menu).

Nara Lunch Menu: available Monday to Friday, 12pm–5pm, excluding bank holidays. One course £12.95, two courses £15.95. Mains available vegetarian or chicken; prawns + £1.50. Vegan options available. Add a soft drink (Coke, Diet Coke, Coke Zero, Fanta, Sprite) for + £2.00.
